note: Hard B, lineage reading: base.json names this recipe's mother, so the declared difference is against that recipe -- not against the framework stock cfg, which would bury this version's own delta in everything its ancestors wrote. Env paths are grouped by who wrote them: the element set that touched the path (several elements can touch one path in sequence), a version-resolved component, or wiring -- the shared wiring reading this recipe's own document. params_version is filtered as identity: it says which recipe this is, and it is what makes the two recipes different at all.

components.commands.why: v5's forward-only window (0, 3) comes from its own yaml, read by the commands component

components.height_sensing.why: v5.1 converts the ring radii to the paper's absolute metres (x5 sole widths)

components.terrain.why: v5 adds the flat bootstrap column and re-scales the slope ends: the SIR curriculum needs a flat start

v3_speed_curriculum+v5_drops_speed_curri.why: v5 drops the staged speed curriculum the linear kernel makes unnecessary (installed by v3, removed here)

v5_reward_package.why: the anti-collapse package: the linear kernel replaces the exp one, r_slip and the belly penalty are added, and the contact penalty narrows to thigh/shank

v5_sir_terrain_curriculum.why: v5.3 hands the terrain curriculum to the row SIR particle filter (band, resampling and replay knobs)

wiring.why: the shared wiring reads this recipe's document: r_fc's sign fix and the narrowed contact-body names

allowed.experiment_name: one version, one log directory (versioning.mdc A)
